title: No vacuous actuality: apart from subjects there is nothing

statements.text: The scheme repudiates the notion of a real thing devoid of subjective immediacy, which it calls vacuous actuality. By the reformed subjectivist principle, apart from the experiences of subjects there is nothing at all.

sources.quote: constitute the repudiation of the notion of vacuous actuality, which haunts realistic philosophy
apart from the experiences of subjects there is nothing, nothing, nothing, bare nothingness
